# Codex integration

Codex reads `AGENTS.md` from the repository root automatically — that file
already documents the scraper API.

For first-class tool access, merge `.codex/config.toml` into
`~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.auto_get_py]
command = "python"
args = ["mcp_server.py"]

[mcp_servers.auto_get_py.env]
AUTO_GET_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8000"
```

Then `codex` gains the tools `scrape`, `quick_scrape`, `fetch_file`,
`task_status`, `task_results`, `cancel_task`, `list_files`.

## Custom prompt

`.codex/prompts/scrape.md` defines a reusable prompt:

```
codex "…"    # then reference the prompt, or paste its body
```
